USGS.citation: Kokaly et al. 2017, USGS Spectral Library 7, https://doi.org/10.5066/F7RR1WDJ
USGS.qualification: Public domain measured directional reflectance factors; not hemispherical albedo. Instrument/sample geometry retained in source title; no colour photographs used.
USGS.verification: admitted local splib07a numeric data read 2026-10-25

COLOR.citation: Wyman, Sloan, Shirley 2013 https://jcgt.org/published/0002/02/01/ ; existing mat-calibrate reference_reader.py
COLOR.qualification: Analytic CIE 1931 approximation, equal energy E, Bradford E to D65; NOT spectral daylight D65. 5 nm quadrature tested against existing 1 nm reader.
COLOR.verification: existing local v5 calibration colour path reused

VAR.citation: Lingappa et al. 2021 https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.2025188118 ; Kuhlman et al. 2008 https://doi.org/10.1029/2007JG000677
VAR.qualification: Millennial Mn-Fe-clay coating; dust source, not host-rock Fe constraint. Broad 1-40 micrometre/kyr reported range, no site-specific rate fit.

RED.qualification: Inherited diagenetic coatings explain Navajo reds; external exposure is not formation age. Qualitative red/orange/pink/white, no numeric Lab standard.

RIND.qualification: Decelerating weathering; square-root penetration is a reduced-order diffusion analogue, not a universal rock rind law or extracted measured coefficient.

MODEL.qualification: Declared reduced-order candidate assumptions, not measurements. No stock transfer is admitted by this predictor.
